result.reason: The clause adds the required frequency cap and business-hours limitation and preserves the 5% cost threshold and independent-auditor concept. However, requiring Licensee to permit an audit “within 30 days” after a request does not provide 30 days’ advance written notice (or even the fallback 15 days). It also does not expressly bind the auditor to confidentiality and does not prohibit direct access to Licensee’s systems. The unexplained relocation of the cost paragraph is unnecessary and reduces drafting coherence. The margin comment cannot cure these operative deficiencies.
